modifications.name: Mill back the receiver feed lips
modifications.effect: The rear of the cartridge rises out of the box sooner, so a long bullet's tip doesn't hang on the chamber or action faces while feeding.

source.name: Community report: project owner's own rifle (Kevin, project thread 2026-11-03)

modifications.note: Filed by the project from the owner's report; no maker or gunsmith page with this step found yet.
